_comment: BUG-002 confound check, created 2026-09-29: originally identical to two_channel_arming_check_600 except arming_class_bin_width_us turned off the class-bin ground-truth diagnostic, to reproduce the pre-instrumentation tick period. That diagnostic was fully retired 2026-10-03 (scenario.py now rejects any nonzero value) - this file's own field is already 0, a no-op, so it is now behaviorally identical to two_channel_arming_check_600.json on that one axis. It still has a live, distinct role, though: neither this file nor two_channel_arming_check_600.json sets core1_interval_us, so both run Core1Runner unpaced/max-rate - this is the scenario named 'bins_off (natural/unpaced)' in two_channel_arming_check_600_deadline.json's own comment and in BUG-002's post-fix generalization check (commit 93a9262). Its sibling '..._bins_off_padded' file no longer exists.
